title: The Group Robustness is in the Details: Revisiting Finetuning under Spurious Correlations

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring Worst-Group Accuracy (WGA) on the CelebA dataset (where hair color classification is spuriously correlated with gender) and the CivilComments dataset (where toxicity classification is correlated with gender identity mentions) under various class-balancing and finetuning strategies.
Measuring Worst-Group Accuracy (WGA) on the CivilComments dataset to evaluate model performance and robustness on comments mentioning racial identities (e.g., black, white) during ERM finetuning.
Measuring Worst-Group Accuracy (WGA) on the CivilComments dataset to evaluate model performance and robustness on comments mentioning religious identities (e.g., Christian, Muslim).
Measuring Worst-Group Accuracy (WGA) on the CivilComments dataset to evaluate model performance on comments mentioning LGBT identities.

Evaluating Worst-Group Accuracy (WGA) on non-demographic spurious features, specifically image backgrounds in the Waterbirds dataset and syntactic negation in the MultiNLI dataset, to test general distributional robustness.
